name: RaidLogManager
tagline: Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies – scored, owned and escalated in one plug-and-play app.
description: A complete RAID log for professional-services engagements: dashboard with exposure and rule breaches, register with bulk actions, probability × impact heat map with drag re-scoring, status board per type, detail panel with escalation ladder and an item form with validation. Works on canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Probability × impact scoring with configurable labels and thresholds
Owner, response and mitigation required for high risks
Needs-attention rules: overdue, stale reviews, missing owner/mitigation
Drag-and-drop and keyboard re-scoring on the heat map
Convert occurred risks to issues; raise risks from invalid assumptions
Bulk review, assign and close with undo
Demo mode, phone layout, ARIA and keyboard support
controlType: standard (2 controls: RaidLogManager data-set + RaidLogManagerPortal field)
